Whether for exploring, building, or navigating, this tool delivers maximum possible performance and a clean interface directly inside your script.

local function createSound(name, id, volume)

	if not root then
		return nil
	end

	local sound = Instance.new("Sound")
	sound.Name = name
	sound.SoundId = "rbxassetid://" .. id
	sound.Volume = volume
	sound.Looped = false
	sound.Parent = root

	return sound
end

--==================================================
-- ESPERAR A QUE CARGUE UN SONIDO
--==================================================

local function waitForSound(sound)

	if not sound then
		return false
	end

	if sound.IsLoaded then
		return true
	end

	local loaded = false

	local connection

	connection = sound.Loaded:Connect(function()
		loaded = true
	end)

	local startTime = os.clock()

	while not loaded and not sound.IsLoaded do

		if os.clock() - startTime >= 8 then
			break
		end

		task.wait()
	end

	if connection then
		connection:Disconnect()
	end

	return sound.IsLoaded
end

--==================================================
-- REPRODUCIR Y ESPERAR
--==================================================

local function playAndWait(sound)

	if not sound then
		return
	end

	if not waitForSound(sound) then
		warn("No se pudo cargar el sonido: " .. sound.SoundId)
		sound:Destroy()
		return
	end

	sound:Play()

	while sound.IsPlaying do
		task.wait()
	end
end

	if not root then
		return

	-- Eliminar loop anterior
	if pandaSound then
		pandaSound:Stop()
		pandaSound:Destroy()
		pandaSound = nil

	pandaSound = Instance.new("Sound")
	pandaSound.Name = "PandaLoop"
	pandaSound.SoundId = "rbxassetid://" .. PANDA_SOUND_ID
	pandaSound.Volume = pandaVolume
	pandaSound.Looped = true
	pandaSound.PlaybackSpeed = 1
	pandaSound.Parent = root

	if waitForSound(pandaSound) then

		if pandaEnabled then
			pandaSound:Play()

			playButton.Text = "⏸  PAUSE"
			status.Text = "● REPRODUCIENDO"
			status.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(110, 220, 125)
		end

	else

		warn("No se pudo cargar el loop del panda.")

		status.Text = "● ERROR DE AUDIO"
		status.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 90, 90)
	end
end

--==================================================
-- 😱 SECUENCIA DE APARICIÓN
--==================================================

local function playPandaArrival()

	if arrivalRunning then
		return
	end

	if not root then
		return
	end

	arrivalRunning = true

	status.Text = "● SUSTO 1"
	status.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 90, 90)

	-- SUSTO 1
	local scare1 = createSound(
		"PandaScare1",
		SCARE_SOUND_1,
		1
	)

	playAndWait(scare1)

	if scare1 then
		scare1:Destroy()
	end

	-- Si el panda fue apagado mientras sonaba
	if not pandaEnabled or not root then
		arrivalRunning = false
		return
	end

	status.Text = "● SUSTO 2"
	status.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 90, 90)

	-- SUSTO 2
	local scare2 = createSound(
		"PandaScare2",
		SCARE_SOUND_2,
		1
	)

	playAndWait(scare2)

	if scare2 then
		scare2:Destroy()
	end

	-- Comprobar otra vez
	if not pandaEnabled or not root then
		arrivalRunning = false
		return
	end

	-- Ahora comienza el loop
	status.Text = "● PANDA LOOP"
	status.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(110, 220, 125)

	startPandaLoop()

	arrivalRunning = false
end

		playButton.Text = "▶  PLAY"
		status.Text = "● PAUSADO"
		status.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 180, 80)

		end

			playButton.Text = "⏸  PAUSE"

			status.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(110, 220, 125)
		else

			end)
		end

	else

		pandaButton.Text = "🐼  PANDA OFF"

		if pandaGui then
			pandaGui.Enabled = false
		end

		if pandaSound then

		end

local function createPanda(character)

	-- Cancelar estado anterior
	arrivalRunning = false

	-- Limpiar sonido anterior
	if pandaSound then
		pandaSound:Stop()
		pandaSound:Destroy()
		pandaSound = nil
	end

	-- Limpiar panda anterior
	if pandaGui then
		pandaGui:Destroy()
		pandaGui = nil
	end

	root = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")

	-- Ocultar avatar localmente
	for _, object in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do

		if object:IsA("BasePart") then
			object.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1

		elseif object:IsA("Decal") then
			object.Transparency = 1
		end
	end

-- Game Functions
local function getCharacter()
    return LocalPlayer.Character

local function getHumanoidRootPart()

local function getTargetPart(player)
    if not player.Character then return nil end
    
    if Config.AimbotTarget == "Head" then
        return player.Character:FindFirstChild("Head")
    elseif Config.AimbotTarget == "Body" then
        return player.Character:FindFirstChild("Torso") or player.Character:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")
    elseif Config.AimbotTarget == "Legs+Body" then
        return player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    elseif Config.AimbotTarget == "Body+Head" then
        local head = player.Character:FindFirstChild("Head")
        local torso = player.Character:FindFirstChild("Torso") or player.Character:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")
        return head or torso
    elseif Config.AimbotTarget == "All" then
        return player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    end
end

local function isInFOV(targetPos)
    local viewportSize = Camera.ViewportSize
    local screenCenter = Vector2.new(viewportSize.X / 2, viewportSize.Y / 2)
    
    local screenPos, onScreen = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(targetPos)
    if not onScreen then return false end
    
    local screenPosition = Vector2.new(screenPos.X, screenPos.Y)
    local distance = (screenPosition - screenCenter).Magnitude
    
    return distance <= Config.AimbotFOV
end

local function getNearestPlayerInFOV()
    local nearestPlayer = nil
    local shortestDistance = math.huge
    local viewportSize = Camera.ViewportSize
    local screenCenter = Vector2.new(viewportSize.X / 2, viewportSize.Y / 2)
    
    for _, player in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player ~= LocalPlayer and player.Character then
            local targetPart = getTargetPart(player)
            if targetPart then
                local screenPos, onScreen = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(targetPart.Position)
                if onScreen and isInFOV(targetPart.Position) then
                    local screenPosition = Vector2.new(screenPos.X, screenPos.Y)
                    local distance = (screenPosition - screenCenter).Magnitude
                    if distance < shortestDistance then
                        shortestDistance = distance
                        nearestPlayer = player
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    
    return nearestPlayer
end

local function getNearestPlayer()

            if theirRootPart then

                if distance < shortestDistance then

                    nearestPlayer = player

local function startAimbot()
    Config.AimbotEnabled = true

    fovUpdateConnection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        local viewportSize = Camera.ViewportSize
        local screenCenter = Vector2.new(viewportSize.X / 2, viewportSize.Y / 2)
        
        -- Update circle position and radius
        FOVCircle.Position = screenCenter
        FOVCircle.Radius = Config.AimbotFOV
        FOVCircle.Visible = true

        rgbHue = rgbHue + 0.01
        if rgbHue >= 1 then
            rgbHue = 0
        end
        FOVCircle.Color = Color3.fromHSV(rgbHue, 1, 1)
    end)
    
    -- Main aimbot logic
    aimbotConnection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        if not Config.AimbotEnabled then return end
        
        -- Only target players within the FOV circle and in front
        local target = getNearestPlayerInFOV()
        if not target or not target.Character then return end
        
        local targetPart = getTargetPart(target)
        if not targetPart then return end
        
        -- Verify target is in front of camera (not behind)
        local cameraLookVector = Camera.CFrame.LookVector
        local targetDirection = (targetPart.Position - Camera.CFrame.Position).Unit
        local dotProduct = cameraLookVector:Dot(targetDirection)
        
        -- Only lock if target is in front (dot product > 0)
        if dotProduct <= 0 then return end
        
        -- Double check if target is still in FOV
        if not isInFOV(targetPart.Position) then return end
        
        -- Smoothly aim at target
        Camera.CFrame = CFrame.new(Camera.CFrame.Position, targetPart.Position)
    end)
    
    print("🎯 Aimbot enabled (RGB circle, only targets players in FOV)")

    Config.BackshotsEnabled = true
    backshotsTarget = getNearestPlayer()
    backshotsCurrentDistance = Config.BackshotsDistance
    backshotsMovingForward = true
    
    if not backshotsTarget then
        print("❌ No player found for backshots")
        Config.BackshotsEnabled = false
        return
    end
    
    print("😈 Backshots activated on: " .. backshotsTarget.Name)
    
    backshotsConnection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        if not Config.BackshotsEnabled then return end
        
        local myRootPart = getHumanoidRootPart()
        if not myRootPart then return end
        
        if not backshotsTarget or not backshotsTarget.Character then
            Config.BackshotsEnabled = false
            return
        end
        
        local targetRootPart = backshotsTarget.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not targetRootPart then return end
        
        -- Animate back and forth movement
        if backshotsMovingForward then
            backshotsCurrentDistance = backshotsCurrentDistance - (Config.BackshotsSpeed * 0.1)
            if backshotsCurrentDistance <= 0.5 then
                backshotsMovingForward = false
            end
        else
            backshotsCurrentDistance = backshotsCurrentDistance + (Config.BackshotsSpeed * 0.1)
            if backshotsCurrentDistance >= Config.BackshotsDistance then
                backshotsMovingForward = true
            end
        end
        
        -- Position behind the target with animated distance
        local behindPosition = targetRootPart.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, backshotsCurrentDistance)
        
        -- Keep character facing the target's back
        local lookAtTarget = CFrame.new(behindPosition.Position, targetRootPart.Position)
        
        myRootPart.CFrame = lookAtTarget
        
        -- Lock camera to view from behind and slightly above
        local cameraOffset = targetRootPart.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 3, Config.BackshotsDistance + 2)
        Camera.CFrame = CFrame.new(cameraOffset.Position, targetRootPart.Position)
    end)

local Players = game:GetService("Players")

-- Main ScreenGui
local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")

screenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
screenGui.Parent = Player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

-- Helper Function to Create Stylish Rounded Drag Frames
local function createStyledCard(pos, size)
    local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
    frame.Size = size
    frame.Position = pos
    frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(35, 35, 45)
    frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
    frame.Active = true
    frame.Draggable = true
    frame.Parent = screenGui

    local uiCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    uiCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12)
    uiCorner.Parent = frame

    local uiGradient = Instance.new("UIGradient")
    uiGradient.Color = ColorSequence.new({
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(45, 45, 60)),
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 30))
    })
    uiGradient.Rotation = 45
    uiGradient.Parent = frame

    local uiStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
    uiStroke.Thickness = 1.5
    uiStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(80, 80, 110)
    uiStroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
    uiStroke.Parent = frame

    return frame
end

-- Core Functionality Definitions
local function tiltCharacter45()
    local char = Player.Character
    if not char then return end
    local humanoidRoot = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not humanoidRoot then return end

    local originalCF = humanoidRoot.CFrame
    local tiltCF = CFrame.Angles(math.rad(90), 0, 0)
    humanoidRoot.CFrame = CFrame.new(originalCF.Position) * tiltCF * originalCF.Rotation
end

local isSpinning = false
local function rotateCamera(deg)
    local root = Player.Character and Player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not root then return end
    local newCFrame = CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(deg), 0) * Camera.CFrame
    Camera.CFrame = CFrame.new(Camera.CFrame.Position) * newCFrame.Rotation
end

local function runSpinSequence(duration)
    if isSpinning then return end
    isSpinning = true
    local startTime = tick()

    task.spawn(function()
        while tick() - startTime < duration do
            rotateCamera(-180)
            RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
            rotateCamera(180)
            RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
        end
        isSpinning = false
    end)
end

local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local runService = game:GetService("RunService")

local tiltState = 0 
local car = nil
local originalGravity = workspace.Gravity
local lowGravity = 50
local normalGravity = 196.2
local isLowGravity = false

local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui", player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui"))
gui.Name = "HajwalaScriptGUI"

local frame = Instance.new("Frame", gui)
frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 200, 0, 130)
frame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -100, 0.7, 0)
frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 15)
frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
frame.Active = true
frame.Draggable = true

Instance.new("UICorner", frame).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)

local title = Instance.new("TextLabel", frame)
title.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30)
title.Text = "⚡ سكربت هجولة ⚡"
title.TextScaled = true
title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
title.BackgroundTransparency = 1

local btnTilt = Instance.new("TextButton", frame)
btnTilt.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 35)
btnTilt.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 38)
btnTilt.Text = "شطف: طافي"
btnTilt.TextScaled = true
btnTilt.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
btnTilt.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 50, 50)
btnTilt.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
Instance.new("UICorner", btnTilt).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)

local btnNotl = Instance.new("TextButton", frame)
btnNotl.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 35)
btnNotl.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 80)
btnNotl.Text = "نطّل: طافي"
btnNotl.TextScaled = true
btnNotl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
btnNotl.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 50, 50)
btnNotl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
Instance.new("UICorner", btnNotl).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)

local function getCar()
    if player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then
        local humanoid = player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if humanoid.SeatPart then
            local seat = humanoid.SeatPart
            if seat and seat.Parent then
                return seat.Parent 
            end
        end
    end
    return nil
end

btnTilt.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function()
    tiltState = (tiltState + 1) % 3
    if tiltState == 0 then
        btnTilt.Text = "شطف: طافي"
    elseif tiltState == 1 then
        btnTilt.Text = "🔥 شطف: يمين"
    else
        btnTilt.Text = "🔥 شطف: يسار"
    end
end)

btnNotl.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function()
    isLowGravity = not isLowGravity
    if isLowGravity then
        workspace.Gravity = lowGravity
        btnNotl.Text = "🚀 نطّل: شغال"
        btnNotl.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 100)
        btnNotl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
    else
        workspace.Gravity = normalGravity
        btnNotl.Text = "نطّل: طافي"
        btnNotl.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 50, 50)
        btnNotl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    end
end)

local hue = 0
runService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    hue = (hue + 1) % 360
    title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromHSV(hue/360, 1, 1)
end)

runService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    car = getCar()
    if not car then 
        return 
    end
    
    local humanoid = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not humanoid or not humanoid.SeatPart then return end
    local seat = humanoid.SeatPart
    
    local gyro = seat:FindFirstChild("CorrectGyro")
    
    if tiltState == 0 then
        if gyro then gyro:Destroy() end
    else
        if not gyro then
            gyro = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
            gyro.Name = "CorrectGyro"
            gyro.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(25000, 25000, 25000)
            gyro.P = 5000
            gyro.D = 300
            gyro.Parent = seat
        end
        
        local rx, ry, _ = seat.CFrame:ToOrientation()
        local targetX = 0 
        local targetZ = 0
        
        if tiltState == 1 then targetZ = math.rad(-14) end
        if tiltState == 2 then targetZ = math.rad(14) end
        
        gyro.CFrame = CFrame.new(seat.Position) * CFrame.fromOrientation(rx, ry, 0) * CFrame.Angles(targetX, 0, targetZ)
    end
end)
